In Wuhan, over 30 children fell ill due to a rapid spread of HMPV, prompting school closures to prevent further transmission. 

The WHO has expressed concern and requested detailed information from China.

nodes.text:
The number of HMPV cases has surged by 529% in just 10 days, overwhelming hospitals.

The virus is particularly dangerous for young children and the elderly.

HMPV symptoms include runny nose, sore throat, fever, cough, fatigue, and headache, typical of respiratory infections.
